title: The effect of Na and Ag doping – alone and in combination – on SnS1−xSex nanostructured thermoelectric materials
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,1303-1312
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01566A, Paper
Itsuki Minowa, Simon Moore, Mari Takahashi, Jun Uzuhashi, Tadakatsu Ohkubo, Shinya Maenosono
In sintered bodies of Ag- and/or Na-doped SnS0.9Se0.1 nanoparticles, Ag increases carrier mobility whilst Na increases carrier concentration. However, when both elements are co-doped, their respective effects cancel each other out.
